segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to review the renewal and the add-on seats before we send the order form. I have you at 68 seats now, moving to 82 on July 1, annual term, $46,740 net after the 12% discount.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That part looks right. My concern is the onboarding item from last week. We agreed the billing tool export had to be mapped to our cost center field before go-live, and your team on the kickoff yesterday had no idea what I was talking about.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so, I owe you an apology there. I agreed to that on the call with you on June 6, and I did not get it into the handoff notes for services. They went into the kickoff with the standard implementation scope, so when you asked about the cost center mapping, it was a surprise to them. That's on me.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It was awkward, honestly. Our controller was on that call, and she thought we were trying to sneak in extra scope. We were very clear this was a must-have for July 15.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally understood. I went back through the email thread and the recording, and you're right. The mapping to the cost center field and the nightly export test by July 10 were agreed. I updated the services brief this morning and got confirmation from Maya on the implementation side that it's now in their work plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Is there any added fee now, or are you honoring what we discussed?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We're honoring it. No additional services fee. The order form will still show the $3,200 implementation line we already discussed, not a change order. I also added a note to the internal approval so deal desk doesn't kick it back.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On payment terms, we need net 45. Finance won't do net 30 this quarter because the invoice will hit before our July close.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Net 45 is fine. I'll put first invoice dated July 1, due August 15. The subscription dates will be July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, and the go-live target stays July 15.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send the revised order form today and copy me and Luis. If the implementation team is aligned now, we can sign by Friday.
